messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 504s detected from regional ingress (eu-west1). Rollup: 504 rate 18% over baseline for the last 5m. Paging oncall (rotation: Emma). Please respond.

Emma: ack, I'm on it, starting with LB/ingress logs and recent deploy checks.

Emma: running quick tail on gateway logs: `kubectl -n gateway logs -l app=ingress --tail=200`

Emma: log snippet shows a lot of upstream timeout traces -> `upstream request timed out after 30s` repeated.

Raj: checking queue depth on gateway workers and model-proxy. Seeing inflight queue rising and model-proxy latency spikes around 1.2-2.5s. Could be upstream saturation or a routing loop.

Maria: I rolled a routing-config change at ~03:08Z to prefer local-cache nodes (v2025-08-12-03). I'll start a rollback if that's suspect.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: routing-config v2025-08-12-03 -> previous stable (v2025-08-11-22). Rolling back across 6 hosts.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: 6/6 hosts -> success.

Emma: after rollback 504s dropped from 18% -> ~4%, still above baseline. Applying temporary edge circuit-breaker to reduce fanout and fail fast for slow upstreams.

Emma: command to update edge config:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/edge/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"circuit_breaker_ms":1500,"max_inflight":200}'
```

Tim Ops: bumped autoscale max for model-proxy to 30 pods (from 12) to absorb queue. `autoscale update --service model-proxy --max 30` - completed.

Maria: hotfix PR opened: #4321 - fix backpressure handling in model-proxy (missing request backoff when upstream returns 502/504). Tests pass in staging. I'll merge after quick review.

Maria: PR #4321 merged and deployed to canary. Observability shows backpressure metrics stabilizing on canary.

Emma: monitoring entire region. Customer impact note: external API 504s affected roughly 1% of EU traffic during the peak; internal SLOs tripped for ~27 minutes. Raised an incident note for status page draft.

Jia: product request — please capture a list of top-5 customers by error volume so we can coordinate comms.

Emma: quick mitigation summary: rollback routing-config, apply circuit-breaker, increase model-proxy autoscale, merge backpressure fix. Residual 504 ~0.8% and trending down.

Emma: immediate action items (short):
- Merge/verify hotfix (#4321) -> Maria (done/merged)
- Add rollback-confirmation step to deploy runbook (check routing-config diff, confirm canary metrics) -> Raj
- Tune alert thresholds: set warning at 5% 504/min and page at 10% -> SRE team
- Postmortem & customer-impact writeup -> Emma (lead), draft due EOD tomorrow
- Customer list & comms draft -> Jia

Raj: I'll update runbook with a new playbook snippet (circuit-breaker apply, rollback steps, and `kubectl` commands). Also adding a KB entry for 'queue backpressure indicators' with example queries.

Emma: handing off to Raj for overnight watch. Summary for next shift: routing rollback done, hotfix merged, autoscale increased, circuit-breaker active, residual error <1% and falling. If sustained >1.5% for 10m, escalate to SEV team and consider temporary regional failover to eu-central.

Raj: ack, taking over monitoring. I'll keep an eye on inflight queues and escalate if trend reverses. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
